title: Have you seen Curaçao Part 2 yet? Two beaches, a night out, and one sweaty climb.
subject: Machu Picchu yesterday, a cold beer today 🍺
paragraphs: POSTCARDS FROM DAINYEL Take the scenic route.
Have you seen Curaçao Part 2 yet? Two beaches, a night out, and one sweaty climb.
I got back from Machu Picchu yesterday. My legs have made it very clear that today’s only elevation gain will be lifting a cold beer. 🍺

Speaking of climbs, have you watched my latest Curaçao vlog yet? In Part 2, I take you along for my last four days on the island. We hit Grote Knip and Cas Abou, go out for the night, and I hike up Mount Christoffel in the Caribbean heat. I was definitely ready for a cold drink after that one too.
If you’ve already watched, hit reply and tell me which beach you’d go back to first. Grote Knip or Cas Abou?
See you on the scenic route, Dainyel
